findings.key_quote: Total sales and revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $20.682 billion, an increase of $3.044 billion, or 17 percent, compared with $17.638 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
findings.justification: This passage also states that total sales and revenues increased 17 percent in Q3 2026 compared to Q3 2025, contradicting the claimed 21% growth.
The XBRL facts show Q3 2026 revenue of $20.682 billion and Q3 2025 revenue of $17.638 billion. The calculated growth rate is ($20.682 - $17.638) / $17.638 = 17.26%, not 21%.
The derived metric shows the year-over-year revenue growth for Q3 2026 was approximately 0.173 or 17.3%, which contradicts the claim of 21% growth.
